Name: Alchemist
Overview:
Alchemist is a puzzle game similar to Bejeweled. In Alchemist, two players attempt to form rows of three or more runes of the same colour to remove them from the board and score points during a preset amount of time. Whichever player has the highest score at the end of the time limit, the player who has scored the most points is the winner. If the player forms a row of colours with a specific series of symbols on them, they will score additional points and potentially remove entire rows or columns from the playboard.

As well as being able to play against an A.I opponent, players can also play up against a human player on a local multiplayer game.
